features: Dolby Audio: Bring a theatre-like feel into your home with the boAt Aavante 2.1 2000d Soundbar. Dolby Audio enhances every scene, pulling you deeper into the visuals with immersive surround sound.

160W boAt Signature Sound: Experience entertainment like never before with the 160W bass-heavy boAt Signature Sound. Whether it’s movies or web series, enjoy a theatre-like vibe from the comfort of your home.

2.1-Channel with Wired Subwoofer: Aavante 2.1 2000d has a 2.1-channel setup, complete with a wired subwoofer to deliver expansive audio that fills the entire room. No matter where you are seated, you will catch every note and beat.

Multi-Channel Connectivity: Stay connected your way with multiple options like Bluetooth v5.4, AUX, optical input, HDMI (ARC), and USB ports. From wireless streaming to wired playback, your soundbar has it all.
EQ Modes: Tailor the audio to suit your content using four dedicated EQ presets like Music, Movies, News, and 3D, for a more personalized and immersive listening experience.

Customized Bass and Treble Controls: Adjust the audio just the way you like it with remote-controlled bass and treble settings. Whether you want booming lows or crisp highs, it's all at your fingertips.
Master Remote: Control everything from the palm of your hand with the all-in-one master remote. Change tracks, tweak settings, or raise the volume without moving an inch.
Sleek Design with Premium Finish: Designed to impress, this soundbar adds a modern touch to your space with its contemporary finish, blending beautifully into any room.
Wall-Mountable Build: Save space and create a neat setup by mounting the Aavante 2.1 2000d on your wall or simply place it on a flat surface for flexible placement options.
